features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Supports ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
notes: Camera capacity is the datasheet's typical figure for 4 MP cameras.
Storage: 2025 datasheet and hardware page give 16 TB; 2023 datasheet gives 4 TB. The 2025 value is used.
2023 datasheet gives LPR support as No; 2025 datasheet gives Yes. LPR support left out.
2023 datasheet gives video output as VGA (1), DVI (1); 2025 datasheet gives HDMI (1), VGA (1). Video output left out.
2023 datasheet gives dimensions as 427 x 251 x 45 mm; 2025 datasheet gives 485 x 254 x 45 mm. Dimensions left out.
2023 datasheet gives maximum power consumption as 65 W; 2025 datasheet gives 150 W. Maximum power consumption left out.
2025 datasheet gives retention as 30 days for 20 cameras at 4 MP.
